selection_policy: latest stable Modrinth release compatible with Minecraft 1.20.1 and Forge; required dependencies are resolved recursively
notes: The first playable technical base contains space exploration and scripting.
The quest system and custom planet content are staged separately; no unverified FTB Quests files are bundled.
YUNG's Better Dungeons adds additional overworld dungeons for early exploration; its required YUNG's API dependency is resolved automatically.
L_Ender's Cataclysm adds challenging boss dungeons; required Curios API and Lionfish-API dependencies are resolved from Modrinth metadata.
